label: signed-Frobenius rho v3 (ladder table, floor-sized DP, ladder check) against rho.signed_frobenius_v2, Koblitz 2^15.4..2^32.1
description: Does the v3 table with distinguished points sized from the floor sqrt(pi r/4n) bring the signed-Frobenius walk to sqrt(pi/2A)? Incumbent rho.signed_frobenius_v2 with an A/A control, interleaved on the four toy-tier Koblitz curves of the 2026-10-06 challenge (1:17, 0:19, 0:23, 1:29) and two medium ones (0:37, 1:43), 24 planted targets each. Counted GAE; local L0 host.
